title: Credits and Charges When a Safe Deposit Box Is Given Up or Exchanged for Another Size
content:
Surrendering one of the bank's Safe Deposit Boxes is the lessee's own decision, made in person with the box emptied and the keys returned.

## What must be settled first

Everything due must be paid before a box is surrendered or moved.

What is due is settled by the amount the bank's own record shows owing on that rental, read before the surrender or the move and matched to the rental in question. The lessee's account of what is outstanding does not settle it.

## Rent credited on surrender

On surrender, rent for the whole unused months is credited at the year's net rent divided by 12 per month, rounded half-up to the cent. Rent for the first rental year is never refunded.

The whole unused months are the whole calendar months remaining after the month containing the surrender or move date, up to the end of the latest rental year charged and paid.

## The key deposit

The key deposit is credited back only when all the keys issued are returned. Where they are not all returned, the lock change charge set for that size is made instead.

## Where a credit balance results

A credit balance resulting from these credits is paid to a PCB checking account of the lessee or by official check.

## Moving to another size

A move to another size at the same branch keeps the anniversary of the lease. The unused whole months of the old box's rent are credited, the new box's net rent is charged for the same months, and the charge for moving to another size applies.

## A surrender worked through on hypothetical facts

Suppose a rental year runs from 1 June to 31 May, the net rent charged and paid for that year is $138.00, and the box is surrendered on 12 September.

1. The month containing the surrender date is September, so the whole calendar months remaining after it, up to 31 May, are October, November, December, January, February, March, April and May: 8 whole unused months.
2. The year's net rent divided by 12 gives $11.50 per month.
3. The rent credit is $11.50 for each of the 8 months, that is $92.00.

Had the year surrendered in been the first rental year of that lease, no rent would be credited at all, however many whole months remained. The net rent of $138.00 and the dates above are hypothetical inputs chosen to work the calculation through.
